coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output matches 2 of 5 variable items at the conceptual level (40%): comparison of ground-truth, subsampled, and MDGEN-generated trajectories, and measurement of torsion-angle autocorrelation. Neither is implemented with all the specified details.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output replaces the specified test-peptide dataset and 30k pooled frames with new simulations, uses 1–2 fs rather than 100 fs reference and output resolution, and varies subsampling intervals. It omits fixed training crops of up to 256 residues, every-40-frame training subsampling, and full-protein inference. Its autocorrelation formula and lag range differ from the reference, and it omits dynamic content defined as the negative derivative of autocorrelation with respect to log-timescale.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states that MDGEN should recover sub-ps oscillations, match ground-truth autocorrelation curves, and exhibit non-monotonic dynamic content, unlike subsampled trajectories.
